fields.Name: IT172 - Gemini Decision 1 Decision Model
fields.Description: Google's Gemini Decision 1 resolves from the synced metadata through AIDecisionRunner to the wire request each route sends (Google AI Studio's Gemini Decisions API via GeminiDecision, and OpenRouter's Decisions API via OpenRouterDecision), with no network. GD1 Google and OpenRouter take API Key credentials; Gemini Decision 1 is an Active Decision model at PowerRank 61 with effective Decision limits 1,000 questions, 255 Choice options, 255 Score levels and 262,144 state tokens, a Google Model Developer row, an Active Google Inference Provider row naming GeminiDecision and gemini-decision-1 (262,144 input tokens) at higher priority than an Active OpenRouter Inference Provider row naming OpenRouterDecision and google/gemini-decision-1-20261111 (262,144 input tokens), and active Realtime cost rows at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0 output on both vendors. GD2 GeminiDecision is registered on BaseDecision, ClassFactory.CreateInstance builds the bundle's guarded subclass reading and trimming a JSON credential's endpoint, and the default endpoint is https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions. GD3 AIDecisionRunner.ExecuteDecision with override naming Gemini Decision 1 on Google POSTs {model: gemini-decision-1, input, questions} with x-goog-api-key and no Authorization header, maps Google's live wire response (omitting model so ResolvedModel stays undefined, with 12-level Score probabilities keyed by 0-based index), and records the MJ: AI Prompt Runs row priced at $0.10/1M input tokens. GD4 the same override on OpenRouter POSTs System One {model: google/gemini-decision-1-20261111, state, questions} with Authorization: Bearer <key>, records ResolvedModel, and prices the run from the OpenRouter cost row. GD5 real encrypted API Key credentials created through CredentialEngine and bound to both Inference Provider rows send raw tokens, never credential JSON. GD6 Google's prompt_feedback.block_reason fails as a retriable ModelError naming the block reason and fails over to OpenRouter. GD7 Google's gateway 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT (with key redaction), decisions-service 400 invalid_request, and 403 PERMISSION_DENIED all fail over cleanly as ModelError to OpenRouter without vendor-removal index skipping. GD8 Default Decision keeps Jev and LLM Decision first and selected, places Gemini Decision 1 on Google then OpenRouter in power-match-fallback order at distance 4 from target rank 57, leaves order and selection unchanged when bound, and fails over to Gemini Decision 1 on Google when drivers ahead fail with ServiceUnavailable.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Gemini Decision 1 resolves with both Google and OpenRouter routes, limits and $0.10/1M cost rows; GeminiDecision builds through ClassFactory; AIDecisionRunner sends each route's exact wire headers and body, maps responses and prices prompt runs; bound encrypted credentials send raw tokens; blocked inputs, 400s and 403s fail over cleanly as ModelError; and Default Decision keeps Jev and LLM Decision first while reaching Gemini Decision 1 only on failover.
